disorder-name.detail: 101 individuals with drug-resistant TLE (55 left onset, 46 right onset) who underwent anterior temporal lobe resection (ATLR). Both pre- and postoperative MRI scans were analyzed. A normative model (GAMM) trained on 924 healthy controls was applied to the TLE cohort to debias morphological measures for age, sex, and scanning protocol.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "We studied 101 individuals with TLE (55 left, 46 right onset) who underwent ATLR." "Anterior temporal lobe resection (ATLR) is a common surgical procedure to treat drug-resistant temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE)."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Patient data collected at the National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery (NHNN) and Chalfont Centre for Epilepsy, both UCL Queen Square-affiliated institutions. No formal public dataset name is given for the clinical cohort.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We used 3T T1-weighted structural magnetic resonance images (MRIs) of 101 individuals with TLE who underwent ATLR at the National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery (NHNN). ... We included individuals with TLE in our study that received a preoperative and postoperative T1-weighted MRI scan between 2010 and 2018 at NHNN or Chalfont Centre for Epilepsy."

age.detail: Age range 19–60 years is mentioned in the Discussion for the clinical cohort; mean and SD are not reported. Table 1 does not include age statistics.
age.supporting_text: "although as subjects in our study were in an age range of 19 e 60 years, there might be age-dependent effects for individuals outside this range"

sex.detail: From Table 1: Left TLE 24M/31F (N=55), Right TLE 16M/30F (N=46). Combined total: 40M/61F (N=101). Percentages calculated from counts: male 40/101=39.6%, female 61/101=60.4%.
